item.title: Trump and China's Xi discuss AI, trade and Iran war during state visit
item.description: U.S. President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping met for the second time this year to much fanfare but little in the way of grand bargains.
item.content:encoded: U.S. President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping met for the second time this year to much fanfare but little in the way of grand bargains.

item.title: Americans are confused and worried about elections. Will that impact turnout?
item.description: New polling shows many voters are concerned about the midterms. But prior elections show no clear link between voter concerns and fewer voters actually casting ballots.
item.content:encoded:
New polling shows many voters are concerned about the midterms. But prior elections show no clear link between voter concerns and fewer voters actually casting ballots.

(Image credit: Win McNamee)

item.title: As election enters its final stretch, some Republicans are distancing from Trump
item.description: With less than six weeks until Election Day, a growing number of Republicans are breaking from Trump on key issues. It comes as the party is scrambling to hold onto a slim majority in Congress.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Congress passed $100 million for teen pregnancy prevention. Most of it is untouched
item.description: With days left to go in the 2026 fiscal year, lawmakers push the health department to spend the money Congress allocated to prevent teen pregnancy. An NPR exclusive.

item.title: Trump's state dinner for Xi features sea bass and a long list of tech titans
item.description: A tech-heavy guest list, the fashion choices of those on it, who sat where and what was on the menu marked the softer — often and glitzier — details of diplomacy as Donald Trump threw a Thursday night state dinner honoring China's leader Xi Jinping.

item.description: The vote on a war powers resolution introduced by Democrats came at a moment when some Republicans have begun to distance themselves from President Trump over the ongoing conflict.

item.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
item.description: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.
